method: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used (MiB), read by hand while the LoRA training ran; not sampled continuously
note: These are point readings, not peaks. nvidia-smi counts everything the process holds, including the PyTorch caching allocator's reserve, so it is not the same unit as torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated (peak_vram_gb in unsloth_A/A_train_seed42.json, 24.5 GiB). Compare the two engines only within the same unit.

runs.engine: INT4 QAT (torchao QATConfig fake quant, full-parameter, transformers Trainer, adamw_8bit, batch 4 x accum 4)
